subject.title: [Bug] WebChat: optimistic USER messages are lost (not just hidden) when chat.send returns before the durable transcript lands — full-replace history reconcile drops them

question: Should `chat.send` return `started` only after a WebChat user turn is durably recorded or guaranteed to progress, or should OpenClaw keep delayed runtime-owned persistence with UI-only pending preservation?
rationale: Both directions are plausible but have different latency, duplicate-suppression, rollover, and failure-visibility tradeoffs that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Require Durable Started Boundary
options.body: Port the useful part of the gateway candidate PR through the current shared recorder/session-accessor path and prove busy same-session, rollover, media, hook, and failure paths.

options.title: Keep Runtime-Owned Persistence
options.body: Keep the current ACK behavior, but document and improve visible failure/audit signals so a `started` ACK does not imply immediate transcript durability.

options.title: Split UI and Gateway Guarantees
options.body: Close only the already-mitigated UI full-replace behavior and track the durable gateway ACK contract in a narrower issue or replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Require Durable Started Boundary
recommendation.body: Port the useful part of the gateway candidate PR through the current shared recorder/session-accessor path and prove busy same-session, rollover, media, hook, and failure paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent WebChat queue/session commits and is the best available routing candidate for the product-contract choice rather than only the transcript implementation mechanics.
